Callout.Name: Vandalism at a School
Callout.Message: Windows broken at a school overnight, caretaker reporting.
Callout.Advisory: Nobody on scene, damage to four windows.

Script.Line: Twelve windows. It took them twenty minutes.
They came over the field and they were gone before I got round there.
I have got the caretaker key and I am the only one on site.

Lines.Approach: Four windows and nobody about. The caretaker will meet you there.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
